name: doeve
tagline: Text or voice-message your computer from your phone and an agent does the task, sending progress photos.
problem: Away from your desk you cannot quickly fetch a file, push a commit or run a script.
solution: An iMessage bridge to an orchestration layer that controls the desktop, reports progress with screenshots and accepts interruptions.
demo_moment: Team-described: text 'push my latest commit' and receive confirmation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Exploring Hybrid Intelligence by Photon” among 195 submissions.
Uses the phone's native messaging as the interface.

lessons: Remote computer control over chat is a compelling agent demo.
